inspection_method: Manual actual-image viewing at native original detail, 720-width and 320-longside. Own immediate-parent was viewed before the edit and used as sole reference. No OCR or code editing of native image.

views.observations: Two intact first words share a top line. The normal Hangul final 빛 is bold and visible below. The wide gap between 로 and 들 is visible; the final glyph sits right of that gap centre. White field remains faintly mottled.
Full phrase reads clearly left to right, then down. First-line words look balanced in size and weight; the final word remains strong. The final glyph is not centred in the first-line gap.
Every word is readable at the actual thumbnail size. Black type forms a shallow central cluster surrounded by a large amount of outside blank space.

copy_check.linebreak_normalization: One upper line and one lower line joined by a single space; user specified no fixed line break.

mandatory_conditions.located_evidence: One native edit result; original.png and final.png are byte-identical copies of the single tool source.

mandatory_conditions.requirement: Exact phrase in normal reading order
mandatory_conditions.located_evidence: Native upper line x46–982, y604–760 reads 틈으로 들어오는; lower line around x439–582, y778–948 reads 빛. All words remain readable at 720 and 320 views.

mandatory_conditions.requirement: Letters and whitespace only; no separate image, decoration, symbols or added copy
mandatory_conditions.located_evidence: Only three Hangul words on white field are identifiable. The short rectangle above the bottom ㅊ is its normal top stroke, not a separate symbol. No picture, ray, slash, logo or extra text observed. Faint field/edge artefacts retained as finish uncertainty.

mandatory_conditions.requirement: Intact word groups and normal Hangul structures
mandatory_conditions.located_evidence: 틈으로 and 들어오는 each remain a complete horizontal word with normal internal spacing. 빛 retains ㅂ, ㅣ and ㅊ; every glyph is complete and inside the frame.

assigned_change_check.requested: Replace simple staggered positions and thinning weight with an actual internal opening
assigned_change_check.observed_result: The first two words now share a baseline and a visibly wider word space; the final 빛 has full black weight. A different typographic relationship was implemented.

assigned_change_check.requested: Final 빛 enters or arrives in that internal opening
assigned_change_check.observed_result: Only partly implemented. The white gap is approximately x406–514 with a centre near x460. The final glyph spans approximately x439–582 with a centre near x511, about 51 pixels right of the gap centre and wider than the gap. Its upper-left edge relates to the gap, but it is not contained or optically centred in the opening.

assigned_change_check.requested: Do not increase outside blank area as substitute for the relation
assigned_change_check.observed_result: Not achieved in the returned composition. Glyphs now occupy approximately y604–948, compared with the parent approximately y406–1158. Top/bottom outside blank area increased, weakening the intended internal-space focus.

comparison_with_immediate_parent.preserved: Exact phrase, 2:3 canvas, black Hangul on white background, intact readable glyphs, no extra content.
comparison_with_immediate_parent.improved_observation: Final 빛 is no longer thinner or lighter; first two words form a single readable line with a distinct internal word gap.
comparison_with_immediate_parent.regressed_or_unresolved_observation: Composition is compressed into a much shallower central band, with more outside whitespace. Gap and final-glyph centres do not align, and final glyph exceeds the gap width. Faint mottling remains.
comparison_with_immediate_parent.selection_status: Repair-stage final.png is this stage’s byte-preserved output. Overall selection remains with coordinator; latest output is not certified better than parent.

retained_defects_uncertainties.location: First-line space between 로 and 들 and lower 빛
retained_defects_uncertainties.observation: Gap centre and final-glyph centre are offset by roughly 51 px; final glyph is roughly 143 px wide while the gap is roughly 108 px. These are manual visual estimates, not pixel segmentation.
retained_defects_uncertainties.impact: The planned arrival into a well-defined opening remains weak and needs independent visual judgment.

retained_defects_uncertainties.location: Whole frame, top and bottom white fields
retained_defects_uncertainties.observation: The visible black cluster spans only about 344 px of the 1536 px height, increasing outside blank area versus the parent.
retained_defects_uncertainties.impact: The correction intent to make internal whitespace the main relation was only partially realized.

retained_defects_uncertainties.location: White background and very faint light edge just above 들
retained_defects_uncertainties.observation: Low-contrast mottling and a faint short edge/halo remain at native view, despite a plain flat-background prompt. No distinct decorative element is identifiable.
retained_defects_uncertainties.impact: Strict plainness and finish are not certified; faint edge should be reviewed against the letters-and-whitespace condition.

production_status.code_image_operations: Exact byte copies; dimension/hash reads; only 720 and 320 QA reductions.

operational_notes: Native view_image preview initially displayed a white strip twice. A subsequent standalone source-path original-detail view displayed the full native image. Both actual QA views displayed correctly. No additional generation or output modification occurred.
